title: E-commerce Profit Dashboard
summary: Real margin per product and per order after shipping and marketplace fees — not just revenue.
result: Real net margin for ~99k orders and 32k products, with loss-making SKUs flagged in one view.

metric.label: orders analyzed with real net margin (Olist public dataset)

note: Built on the public Olist Brazilian e-commerce dataset. Product cost is simulated (Olist does not publish it) and is labeled as simulated in the report.

screenshots.alt: Profit overview: revenue, fees, freight and net margin by month and category
Products ranked by net margin, loss-making SKUs flagged

upworkBlurb: Power BI profit dashboard for an e-commerce store, built on the public Olist dataset (~99k orders). It calculates real net margin per product and per order after shipping and marketplace fees, and flags SKUs that sell at a loss. Includes a monthly P&L view, product ranking and drill-down to order level. Product cost is simulated and clearly labeled. Stack: Power BI, DAX, Power Query, SQL, Python. I can build the same for your Shopify, Amazon or WooCommerce data.
